customizationHint: Saved only in this browser, separately for each home. Hidden rooms and readings are omitted from the dashboard and room details; you can always restore them here.
iconLimits: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MiB and 16 megapixels. Resized to at most 128×128 px, stored locally up to 64 KiB per icon.
iconUploadError: Could not use this image. Choose a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP within the stated limits.
preferenceSaveError: Could not save your preferences. Browser storage may be full or disabled. Your previous settings have been kept.
noVisibleMeasurements: All readings are hidden. You can show them again in Settings.
roomNotFound: This room is unavailable or has no visible readings. Check your visibility choices in Settings.
tagline: Your home, in a clearer light.
intro: One quiet place for the climate of your home. Connect your Netatmo account to see your thermostat and weather stations, room by room.
demoNotice: Demonstration with simulated data. No real devices are connected.
privacy: Read-only access. Your Netatmo tokens never reach the browser.
configuration: Netatmo sign-in has not been configured yet.
orderHint: Drag the handles to reorder rooms and readings within each room. Changes are saved automatically for this home in this browser and applied to the dashboard.
sortKeyboard: Keyboard: press Space to pick up an item, use the arrow keys to move it, press Space or Enter to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
rainHistory: Rain history shows the accumulation in each 30-minute interval.
noHomes: No supported homes or stations are authorized for this account.
noMeasurements: No supported measurements were found in this home.
error: Could not retrieve the data. Please try again.
authError: Netatmo authorization was canceled or failed. Please try again.
historyMissing: This measurement has no supported history.
notFound: This measurement is no longer available.
